name: Watson Museum and Jubilee Garden Tour
description: Discover Saurashtra's royal artefacts, colonial portraits, and ancient inscriptions nestled inside lush gardens.

name: Kaba Gandhi No Delo (Mahatma Gandhi Memorial)
description: Walk through the ancestral residence where Mahatma Gandhi spent his formative childhood years.

name: Traditional Kathiyawadi Thali Experience
description: Savor authentic Kathiyawadi cuisine including Ringna no Oro, Bajra no Rotlo, and freshly churned Chaas.

name: Aji Dam & Sunset Promenade
description: Enjoy scenic views across the reservoir, beautiful water fountains, and manicured parklands at twilight.

name: Heritage Old City Pol Walking Tour
description: Explore UNESCO-inscribed labyrinthine pols, intricately carved wooden havelis, and secret bird feeders.

name: Sabarmati Ashram Peace Walk
description: Stand in the serene courtyard of Hriday Kunj where the historic Dandi Salt March commenced.

name: Manek Chowk Midnight Street Food Safari
description: Feast on world-famous Gwalior dosas, chocolate pineapple sandwiches, and fresh Jamun shots after dusk.

name: Adalaj Stepwell Architectural Exploration
description: Marvel at five stories of subterranean Solanki architecture, geometric columns, and ornate carvings.

name: Gateway of India & Colaba Heritage Walk
description: Witness the grand basalt arch facing the Arabian Sea, the iconic Taj Mahal Palace hotel, and Art Deco marvels.

name: Elephanta Caves Island Boat Trip
description: Ferry across Mumbai Harbour to ancient rock-cut basalt cave temples depicting Lord Shiva.

name: Marine Drive Sunset & Chowpatty Street Eats
description: Stroll along Queen’s Necklace, watch the golden sun dip into the sea, and taste crispy bhel puri.

name: Qutub Minar & Mehrauli Archaeological Park
description: Towering 73-meter minaret surrounded by intricately carved sandstone pavilions from the Delhi Sultanate.

name: Old Delhi Chandni Chowk Rickshaw & Food Trail
description: Glide through fragrant spice markets, Paranthe Wali Gali, and the majestic Jama Masjid courtyard.

name: Humayun’s Tomb Garden Walk
description: The magnificent precursor to the Taj Mahal surrounded by four-part Persian Charbagh geometric gardens.

name: Cubbon Park Botanical Stroll & Filter Coffee
description: Walk under canopy bamboos, century-old mahogany trees, and enjoy authentic South Indian filter kaapi.

name: Indiranagar Microbrewery & Gastropub Tour
description: Sample artisanal IPAs, wheat beers, and innovative fusion culinary pairings in India's pub capital.

name: Eiffel Tower Summit & Champagne Tasting
description: Ascend to the panoramic pinnacle of Paris for breathtaking 360-degree views and chilled bubbly.

name: Louvre Museum Masterpieces with Art Historian
description: Skip-the-line journey through the world’s greatest art collection including Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo.

name: Seine River Sunset Dinner Cruise
description: Glide past illuminated monuments while savoring a 3-course French gourmet meal on glass-canopied boat.

name: Tower of London & Crown Jewels Discovery
description: Uncover nearly 1,000 years of royal intrigue, fortress battlements, and the world's most dazzling gems.

name: Borough Market Artisanal Food Safari
description: Taste warm Scottish scotch eggs, melted raclette cheese, oysters, and British fudge under Victorian arches.

name: Colosseum Underground & Gladiator Arena Floor
description: Walk through the subterranean tunnels where gladiators and wild beasts awaited combat in ancient Rome.

name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel Tour
description: Gaze up at Michelangelo’s ceiling frescoes and explore St. Peter's Basilica with an expert historian.

name: Fushimi Inari 10,000 Torii Gates Morning Hike
description: Hike through the vibrant vermilion wooden shrine gates winding up the sacred Mount Inari.

name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove & Tenryu-ji Zen Temple
description: Immerse in towering green bamboo groves and centuries-old landscaped Zen rock and pond gardens.

name: Burj Khalifa 'At the Top' Level 148 Lounge
description: Ascend the world's tallest tower to the observation lounge for horizon views of the Arabian Gulf.

name: Red Sand Dune Safari & Bedouin BBQ Camp
description: 4x4 dune bashing, sandboarding, camel rides, and Arabic barbecue under starry Arabian desert skies.

name: Shibuya Crossing & Harajuku Vintage Street Hunt
description: Navigate the world’s busiest pedestrian crossing, trendy Takeshita Street, and hidden vinyl cafés.

name: Tsukiji Outer Fish Market Sushi Tasting
description: Watch master chefs slice fresh Otoro bluefin tuna, sea urchin, and wagyu beef skewers.

name: Central Park Bicycle Tour & Strawberry Fields
description: Pedal along tranquil lakes, Bow Bridge, and the memorial to John Lennon in Manhattan's crown jewel.

name: Sagrada Familia & Gaudí Architecture Tour
description: Marvel at Antoni Gaudí’s uncompleted basilica masterpiece, stained-glass light forest, and stone towers.

name: Ubud Tegallalang Rice Terrace & Jungle Swing
description: Soar over terraced emerald rice paddies on a thrilling jungle swing with views of coconut palms.

name: Uluwatu Cliff Temple & Sunset Kecak Fire Dance
description: Watch dramatic coastal cliff sunset followed by the hypnotic rhythmic chanting of the Kecak dance.

name: Sydney Harbour Bridge Climb & Sunset
description: Scale the iconic steel arches 134 meters above Sydney Harbour for unmatched panoramic views.

name: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Cliff Walk
description: Breathtaking 6km coastal trail past sandy beaches, sandstone cliffs, rock pools, and ocean views.
